facts.fact: Burundi Times reports that the OBR launched the implementation phase of E-KORI, a new integrated digital platform for online declaration and payment of taxes and duties, with World Bank technical and financial support, and that the Finance Ministry says taxpayers will declare and pay remotely once it is fully operational.

note: Tele-declaration modernisation is named as a purpose only; no system procured, piloted or in service stated.

facts.fact: OBR says taxpayers file returns online on the Umutangakori portal, in use since 1 August 2023 for large and medium taxpayers.
OBR says taxes are paid online through the Umutangakori portal, with receipts issued by the same channel.
